{{Quote|I saw them die years ago. No one survived that explosion.|Shodarra|<ref name="RotBB" />}}
'''Shodarra''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. He served in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and during the [[Battle of Rhen Var]] witnessed the demise of the famed [[Bane Brigade]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth (Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]] over ten years later he was discussing with fellow Generals [[Krepkit]] and [[Uchang]] the news that the Bane Brigade has resurfaced on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Uchang advised to bring more reinforcements to Hoth, but Shodarra countered by saying that he saw the Bane Brigade perish himself.
